subject: PhotonAI - Dedicated GPU pool pricing addendum & competitive match request
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Susan Park <susan@photon.ai>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@photon.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: PhotonAI Dedicated capacity - info needed for pricing addendum

Hi Susan / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. To help me prepare an internal request for a competitive addendum, can you confirm the key pieces of the Zephyr proposal that matter most to you? Specifically:

- Committed GPU count and burst behavior (do they let you burst beyond committed pool and for how long?)
- Any onboarding or migration credits they offered (one-time $ value)
- Required throughput or latency commitments (p50/p95 targets you were promised)
- Contract term and any early-termination flexibility

If you can share the redline or the pricing sheet (even a screenshot), that would be ideal — we can run a side-by-side and see where we can be more competitive. I can escalate an exception for strategic accounts, but I need a clear ask.

Proposed internal ask (so you have context): one-time onboarding credit + a short period discounted rate on the committed pool to match the effective price. If that maps to what Zephyr gave, tell me the numbers and I’ll push it up.

I’ve cc’d Marissa (pricing lead) to keep the loop tight.

Thanks —
Jonas
Senior Account Exec | Redwood Inference
mobile: +1 415-555-0156

From: Susan Park <susan@photon.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@photon.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 18:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: PhotonAI Dedicated capacity - info needed for pricing addendum

Jonas —

Appreciate the quick follow. High level summary of Zephyr’s offer (they sent a formal quote this morning):

- Committed: 8x A100-equivalent GPU pool (regional, us-west) with ability to burst to 12x for up to 60 minutes/day aggregated. Burst is charged at a lower "burst rate" but not capped further.
- Onboarding credit: one-time $75,000 credit applied to first invoice (covers part of migration and validation work).
- Effective discount: around ~18% off rack rate for the first 9 months, then standard rate.
- SLA: 99.5% availability, no explicit p95 latency guarantee in the doc; they did commit to "low-latency serving" and offered a short technical validation window.
- Term: 12-month minimum, with 90-day notice for changes.

We like Redwood but the credit and the burst flexibility are what pushed Zephyr to the lead in the procurement team discussion. We’re hoping Redwood can match a similar effective economics (or offer stronger throughput guarantees) — the migration timeline is tight. I attached the Zephyr quote and our internal cost comparison (pricing-comparison-photonai.xlsx).

Thanks,
Susan
Head of Platform Engineering | PhotonAI

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Susan Park <susan@photon.ai>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@photon.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: PhotonAI Dedicated capacity - info needed for pricing addendum

Marissa / Laura —

Forwarding Susan’s summary and the Zephyr quote. Key customer asks to consider when we build an exception:

- Match effective economics of ~18% for first 9 months OR provide a meaningful onboarding credit to offset migration costs.
- Provide a documented burst model: customer needs to burst to ~150% of committed for short periods without extreme overage costs.
- They want a regional (us-west) pool and a throughput validation run during onboarding.

Notes: I think we can be flexible on a one-time credit and a limited burst allowance if operations scopes the risk and legal signs off on a short addendum. Laura, can you flag any legal constraints for offering a temporary discounted rate (e.g., minimum term, audit/usage clauses)?

If you want a suggested ask for escalation: 8% committed discount for 12 months + $60k onboarding credit + burst allowance up to 150% of pool for 60 min/day at a fixed capped burst rate. I’m asking for VP approval to grant that exception if needed.

Jonas

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 11:44:23 -0700
Subject: Re: PhotonAI Dedicated capacity - info needed for pricing addendum

Team —

I’ve run the numbers with product and finance. Summary and recommended exception package (strategic account playbook):

- Offer: 8% off committed pool list price for first 12 months (reverts to standard pricing thereafter).
- Onboarding credit: $60,000 one-time credit to be applied to the first invoice; limited to onboarding costs and validation (documented in SOW).
- Burst policy: allow burst to 150% of committed pool for up to 60 min/day aggregated, billed at a fixed capped burst rate (we estimate marginal cost to us at ~40% of list for burst below 60 min/day).
- Commit: 12-month minimum term; 3-month notice for scale-down.
- Operational guardrails: require the customer to run an initial throughput validation within first 30 days; if we see sustained >150% usage, we reserve right to renegotiate pricing.

Risks: the credit is the primary concession. We can mitigate by tying credit to completion of the validation and signed SOW that limits credit application. Legal (Laura) — need a short addendum + SOW and clear language for burst-rate cap and validation steps.

If VP Sales (Vivek) signs off, I’ll draft the pricing addendum and hand to Laura for legal redline. I’ve attached the pricing comparison and a draft SLA with these terms (PhotonAI_SLA_draft.pdf).

Marissa
Head of Pricing | Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PhotonAI Dedicated capacity - info needed for pricing addendum

Marissa / team —

Approve with a small modification: reduce onboarding credit to $50k (still meaningful to the customer) and keep the rest of the package intact. Conditions:

- 12-month minimum commit required and add a clause that credit is forfeited if we terminate for cause.
- Add a HubSpot task for Jonas to obtain a signed addendum by EOD next week and include the Zephyr quote as an attachment for audit.

Jonas — proceed to present this to PhotonAI. If they push for a higher credit, escalate back to me with a one-paragraph business case (ARR, expansion likelihood, strategic rationale).

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
